description: Unlock and return an active venue dossier (booking contacts, dead-email warnings, submission rules, typical ticket prices, usual music days, room/load-in context, and dated show listings) for 7 days by spending 1 free reveal if the venue is not already revealed. Permanently closed venues cannot be revealed and spend no reveal. Call this only when the user explicitly asks to reveal or unlock a specific venue.
name: reveal_venue
title: Reveal Full Venue Details
